name: hexaemeron
description: Issue-free delivery loop: study, runbook, then per-step implement/audit/prose/push to a working prototype, receipt-backed and resumable.

interface.shortDescription: Issue-free delivery loop with receipts: study, runbook, build, audit, prose, push.
interface.longDescription: Takes a topic from nothing to a working prototype through a receipt-backed controller: a linted study, a runbook of discrete steps, then per step the simplest satisfying implementation, a security loop over the vendored Pashov suite (x-ray, solidity-auditor, fizz) until clean or reasoned out, a prose pass through the bundled imprimatur and vulgate masks, and a pushed PR. Completed state is archived and reset automatically when a new run begins; incomplete state remains resumable.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $hexaemeron:fiat to start "<topic>" in the current repository without creating GitHub issues. If existing controller state is complete, archive and reset it automatically before starting.
